cues.text: Sunbeams pierce dark clouds over a misty, green valley. A massive white spaceship rests on the grass.
Tall, robotic beings with dark, angular armor and glowing orange joints survey the untamed jungle.
One steps onto a rock in the foreground. Black shards orbit its floating, diamond-shaped head.
It holds a glowing pink flower.
The flower has transformed into a pristine, geometric white crystal. It hovers and turns slowly above the being's hand.
The being gazes at the perfect, angular shape.
Everything slowly fades into absolute darkness.

beats.note: Sunbeams break through dark clouds over a misty, green valley where a massive white spaceship has landed.
Several tall, robotic beings with dark, angular armor and glowing orange joints stand among the trees.
One of the beings steps onto a mossy rock in the foreground. Its head is a hollow, floating diamond surrounded by orbiting black shards.
The being in the foreground holds a glowing pink flower in its hand.
The flower begins to lose its organic petals, transforming into sharp geometric shapes.
The flower has completely transformed into a glowing white, geometric crystal hovering above the being's hand.
The image begins to fade to black.
